question: Verify SRA hard-label input contract, actual batch-trigger exposure, and score-to-augmentation decisions without changing logits or launching training.
datasets: Only the existing 589 development logits and train/dev manifest counts; no sealed data, no images or training/checkpoint forward.
comparisons: Exact original forward AST executed with a fixed-logit encoder stub, original hard-label tensor (B,), training=True and use_basic_aug=False; compare to the same method changing only the shape-test condition, the prior adapter and independent NumPy formula.
Existing forced groups (15x37 +34) are explicitly artificial collision probes, never described as actual training exposure.

Shadow schedule for current local total batch16 and for official total batch256 on the same 589 cache rows: score only second-half rows, retain natural final batch. This is compatibility replay, not a training run.

Official default loader arithmetic: CIFAR10/100 N50000 total batch256; ImageNet N1281167, world4, per-rank batch512, DistributedSampler padding and final batch retained. Actual old Pets N591/train and589/dev batch16 plain RA does not call SRA.
Declared hypothetical supported-input demonstrations: CIFAR10 total batch20 and a batch20 tail after totalbatch64; these show contract reachability but are not actual observed configurations.

On fixed forced groups and matched torch/NumPy RNG, run exact SRA forward/_apply_op AST with logging no-op pixel operators; execute each operator's original magnitude-to-argument AST. Use actual script settings depth2 and p_min_t=p_max_t=1, 14 operations in original order. Record selected operation, application decision and argument for original/corrected/oracle scores.
metrics: Triggering batch/sample counts under each real versus hypothetical schedule
Per-group rank Spearman and pairwise ordering inversion fraction; ties broken by source ID for rankings, explicit pair ties recorded
Per-group top-quartile membership overlap, ceil(B/4); descriptive only, SRA itself does not select by rank
Per-operation counts and differences in selected operator/application gates

Applied magnitude differences and operator-argument deltas with units; geometric sign/direction, degree/fraction/shear, photometric factor, Solarize threshold, Posterize continuous parameter. Ignore-magnitude operations are negative controls.
Number of source records with at least one magnitude-sensitive operator argument changed; count all rows and collision rows separately.
float_primary: float64 fixed logits; tensor images are synthetic placeholders only, no raster transforms/model encoder executed

resources.purpose_of_second: only independently verify saved outputs or a documented technical repair
resources.downloads: public source text only, no datasets/weights/dependencies

stop_conditions: If the original official forward does not accept standard hard-label shape, invalidate the misuse claim and stop before impact interpretation.
If repaired path disagrees with independent formula or noncollision controls fail, stop as invalid measurement; retain failure.
If operation selection or gating differs with identical RNG, diagnose instrumentation/RNG mismatch before claiming selection effects.
If all actual recorded/default configurations have zero triggers, archive as implementation case; do not propose or launch downstream training solely on artificial B=C.
Only an actual intended/recorded supported configuration with trigger and nonzero decision impact warrants proposing a separate fair downstream budget. No full18-21run matrix.
Never alter source snapshots or old results; no ps retry, OpenReview retry/bypass, remote writes, issues, messages, PRs, fees or GPU contention.
limitations: Original requested PyTorch1.13.1 is not installed or executed; native score semantics are checked on existing local PyTorch2.14.1.
Instrumented exact methods isolate input routing and parameter decisions; they do not execute trained model layers or actual image transformations.
Rank changes need not imply operation-selection changes; SRA chooses operation names independently of score.
